To understand this, imagine a server farm with multiple servers. When a user types www.example.com, the DNS resolver looks up the IP address for that domain. The server then tries to process all those responses simultaneously, which overwhelms its memory and CPU.

To defend against this, organizations implement rate limiting, DNS filtering, and load balancing. These tools monitor traffic patterns and block requests that exceed a threshold. They also use DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) to encrypt the DNS query, making it harder for attackers to intercept.

## Introduction

The residential schools system emerged in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, primarily in the United States and Canada. These institutions operated under the assumption that assimilation was the primary goal, often prioritizing assimilation over the children's welfare.
